people.imagined: In the horse lines at dusk he is brushing down a mare and speaks to a young blade about debts, his head tilted a little to the right to keep the ruined left ear out of sight.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk in a horse line, he leans his forearm on a mare's neck and tilts his head to the right as he speaks, hiding his damaged ear without quite managing it. Face (most important: the frost-ruined ear): a long, lean, weathered face; his LEFT ear is half gone, the top half a jagged, shrivelled stump of pink scar tissue, clearly visible on the near side; steady, patient hazel eyes; grey bushy brows; a long nose with a split vein; a calm, slightly crooked mouth; a short grey moustache. Hair: grey, long, tied in a horsetail low at the nape under a dark silk headwrap with a gold pin, the ear showing. Body: lean, tall, slightly bowed from long years in the saddle, broad shoulders, big hands cracked from rein and brush. Clothing: a deep night-blue silk robe with a dune-gold second collar and a flowing sand-coloured gauze over-robe, wide sleeves, pale-gold crescent moons embroidered along the borders, a red wool band on the upper arm; a sash with a glowing jade-green night-glow cup on a cord at the hip. Hands and objects: a horse brush in the right hand, resting on the mare's neck; a bay mare with a rope halter. A well-made straight double-edged sword in a red-brown scabbard is slung diagonally across the back; its copper guard and the grip wrapped in rust-red cord show above the left shoulder. Power: faint ember-red motes of fire qi rise from his hands and drift along the mare's neck. Background: a long line of horses in dusk mist, tents, a thread of cook-fire smoke beside him. Light: low amber sunset glow from the upper left, a soft gold rim along his grey hair. Expression: a slow, patient half-smile and steady hazel eyes, the settled calm of an old rider who has already forgiven the world.

people.imagined: Pouring a night-glowing cup for the young blades at the fire, her thumb and finger straining at the cup-shaped scar where her grandfather's jade cup split. She watches who drinks.
people.subject: The moment: at a night fire she tilts a green jade ewer to pour into a cup held out to the viewer, with a proud, cold, level stare. Face: a sharp, handsome, arrogant face; high cheekbones; narrow black eyes; thin high-arched brows; a straight nose; a thin red mouth with the corners lifted; a faint rider's tan. Hair: black, tied in a high topknot with a red cord and a gold pin, under a dark silk headwrap. Body: tall, long-limbed, shoulders squared. Clothing: a fine night-blue silk robe with a dune-gold collar and a drifting sand gauze over-robe, wide sleeves embroidered with pale-gold crescent moons and stars, a red wool band on the upper arm and a red tassel at the shoulder, a sash set with a small jade cup, a sabre on the belt; a richly worked, fitted cut. Hands and objects (the scar must read): between her right thumb and forefinger, a pale, cup-shaped crescent scar like a half-moon, plainly visible against her tan as she grips the ewer; in the other hand, a night-glowing jade cup, pale green, glowing faintly from within. Power: a thin ember-red shimmer of fire qi gathers around her wrists and glints in her eyes, strong and controlled. Background: a dark orange campfire in mist, felt tents, sparks rising like fireflies. Light: orange firelight from below left and the green glow of the cup under her chin, a gold rim on her cheek. Expression: a proud, cold, level stare with a lifted chin and a thin smile that dares the drinker.

people.imagined: Riding at dawn on the Hồi Lan road, she turns in her saddle and waves a hand at the rider one dune behind, laughing, the bell in her braid jingling.
people.subject: The moment: on a camel at dawn she twists round in the saddle and waves over her shoulder with a wide, friendly grin, a brass bell jangling in her braid. Face: a round, sun-browned, cheerful face; bright dark brown eyes crinkled with laughter; soft level brows; a button nose; a big warm mouth. A scatter of freckles crosses her nose and the sun has reddened the tops of her cheeks. Hair: black, in one long braid over the shoulder with a small round brass camel bell tied into it, plainly visible and hanging by her cheek, a night-blue ribbon wound through. Body: sturdy and strong, a rider's easy seat. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a young disciple: a night-blue robe with a dune-gold crossed collar and a light sand-coloured gauze over-robe, sleeves bound at the wrist for riding, a faded blue dust scarf at her neck, a few small pale-gold moons embroidered at the hem; a pale glass night-glow cup on a cord at her hip; a short curved sabre on the belt. Hands and objects: her right hand waving, her left holding the camel's rope rein; behind her, a woolly saddlebag with a bundle of cloth. Power: none, only a few faint warm motes of dawn dust turning gold in the light. Background: pale sand dunes under a pink sky with a small distant rider on the ridge; the camel's shaggy neck and one tufted ear rise at the lower edge of the frame, with a long shadow of the rider across the sand. Light: soft pink dawn light from the upper left, a gold rim on her braid. Expression: a wide, honest, laughing grin with crinkled eyes, the face of a girl who has never met a stranger she did not want to wave at.

people.imagined: In the stable at dusk he leans his forehead against the grey mare's face while she nuzzles his shoulder. No one else has ever looked at him with that much approval.
people.subject: The moment: in a stable by lantern-glow, a plain young man rests his cheek on the neck of a grey mare who nuzzles his shoulder, his eyes closed in contentment. Face: a long, plain, unremarkable face, narrow, with a long jaw and a big nose; mild brown eyes; thin straight brows; a wide, gentle mouth with a slight smile; sunburnt. His ears are large and slightly flushed, and a few straw-coloured stubble hairs show along the long jaw. Hair: brown, short, straw stuck in it. Body: lanky and loose-limbed, long arms. Clothing: the plainest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a night-blue robe with a dune-gold collar, clean but unadorned, no red band, a grey wool dust scarf, sleeves rolled; plain boots worn down at the heels but oiled; a strip of grey wool tied round his left wrist. Hands and objects: one hand strokes the mare's nose; the other holds a currycomb; a night-glow cup of pale glass hangs on a cord at his belt. The mare is a handsome silver-grey with a dark mane and a red bridle tassel. Slung across the back, the hilt of a plain narrow straight sword rises past the right shoulder, in an ochre-brown scabbard, the grip wrapped in tan cord, a dull bronze guard. Power: a faint earth-ochre glow of earth qi lies on his hands and the mare's coat. Background: a dark stable stall in mist, hay, a hanging lantern. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left, a thin shaft of silver spirit-light falling across the mare's neck and his cheek. Expression: closed eyes and a slack, contented smile, cheek relaxed against the mare's neck.

people.imagined: On a night ride, he holds a rope taut across the road, fist clenched, the black veins on the back of his hand standing out, and watches a driver stumble with no expression.
people.subject: The moment: at night he stands with a thick rope wrapped round his right fist, the back of that hand clearly visible and marked with black branching veins climbing from the wrist to the knuckles, and looks flatly past the viewer. Face: a hard, handsome, narrow young face; flat black eyes with no light in them; straight dark brows; a thin nose; a thin mouth with no expression. A thin pale scar runs through his left brow and a muscle stands in his jaw. Hair: black, in a tight high tail with a red cord, under a dark silk headwrap with a gold pin. Body: lean and tall, rigid. Clothing: a dark night-blue silk robe with a dune-gold collar and a sand-grey gauze over-robe, fine and clean, wide sleeves bound at the wrist, pale-gold crescent moons at the border, a red cord tassel at the shoulder, tall boots; a black curved sabre on the belt; a green glass night-glow cup on a cord at the sash. Hands and objects: the black-veined right hand clenched on the rope; the left on the sabre grip. Power: a dark, dull-red shimmer of fire qi crawls along the black veins and gathers at the rope, quietly menacing. Background: a night road in mist, a line of dark wagon shapes and the small gold flame of a caravan lantern receding behind him. Light: cold moonlight from the upper left and a thin orange rim from a fire at right. Expression: a flat, lightless stare and a mouth held perfectly still, the hard calm of someone who feels nothing about what he is watching.

people.imagined: At a raiders' fire, welcomed loudly, she sits stiffly with her cut-down blue sash tied tight round her wrist and her eyes on the one deserter she does not trust.
people.subject: The moment: at a campfire she sits upright with arms folded and eyes sliding sideways toward someone off to the left, a strip of blue cloth tightly tied round her right wrist. Face: a narrow, pale, sharp young face; wary dark eyes; strong thin brows; a thin straight nose; a tight mouth. A thin line of dark kohl runs along each lower lid, newly applied to look like the riders she joined. Hair: black, short, cropped, with a loose strand, a new dark silk headband with a small gold pin. Body: slender, wiry, rigid. Clothing: a new night-blue silk robe with a dune-gold collar and a sand gauze over-robe, still crisp with fold lines from the bale, its red band a shade too bright against the weathered silks around her; wide sleeves, a few pale-gold stars at the hem, boots, a short sabre on the belt. Hands and objects: the blue guard's sash cut down and knotted tight round her wrist as a plain wristband, clearly visible against the dark sleeve; a pale glass night-glow cup in her other hand, untouched; a small folded slip of paper in her sleeve cuff. Power: a faint blue-grey glint of metal qi along her wristband, barely there. Background: a loud camp in mist, riders' backs, a fire; behind her a rider throws back his head in a laugh, a tilted jug at his lips, though she does not turn. Light: orange firelight from the lower right, cold blue spirit-light on her face from the upper left. Expression: a tense, guarded face with a tight mouth and eyes cut sideways, lonely in the firelit crowd.

people.imagined: In a glass-blower's hut with a fresh cup glowing on the pipe's end, she tips her hand into her pocket and rolls a few glass beads, glancing up to check no one has seen.
people.subject: The moment: in a small glass hut she holds a blow-pipe with a bulb of glowing glass at its end in one hand while the other dips into her pocket, thumb moving over glass beads, her eyes sliding up warily. Face: a round, shrewd, flushed face; small bright dark eyes; thin arched brows; a short nose; a pursed mouth; sweat on the cheeks. Hair: dark brown, in a thick bun under a dark silk band with a gold pin, with a loose strand stuck to the forehead. Body: stout, short, strong forearms. Clothing: a night-blue silk robe with a dune-gold collar, sleeves rolled and tied back, a sand gauze scarf wet at the neck, a red wool cord round the upper arm, a dark glassworker's apron of supple cloth worn over the sash, gloves tucked in her belt. Hands and objects: a long iron blowpipe with an orange-glowing glass bulb; in her pocket the pale glint of beads, a few round glass beads showing between her thumb and forefinger, each a small blue or amber spark; shelves of finished glass cups with a faint green glow behind her. Past the right shoulder rises the rust-red-corded hilt of a plain long straight sword slung on the back, its red-brown scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of steel darkened to a warm tint. Power: ember-red motes of fire qi shimmer in the heat above the bulb. Background: a furnace mouth glowing like a small sun in a smoky hut, the shimmer of heat bending the air above it. Light: bright orange furnace light from the lower left with the green glow of finished cups, a gold rim on her cheek. Expression: a pursed, narrow-eyed look of quick calculation, the mouth tight and the glance sliding up from her pocket like a woman counting what she has just kept.

people.imagined: On the Đà Linh road at midday, she smiles at an envoy of the Pavilion with her feathered sabre at her hip. She is working out the toll. The envoy is not comfortable.
people.subject: The moment: at a roadside halt she gives a slow, thin, friendly smile to the viewer, her head tilted a little and one hand toying with a hawk feather on her sabre's pommel. Face: a lean, hard, handsome desert face; sharp cheekbones; long dark amber eyes with a glitter; thin arched brows; a long straight nose; a thin red-lipped smile just a little too wide, which is the mark of her; a small scar at the left lip. Hair: black, tied in a long tail under a red felt cap fixed with a gold pin. Body: lean, tall, tough, loose-hipped, rider's stance. Clothing: an elder's rich robes: a night-blue silk robe with two dune-gold crossed collars under an over-robe of RED-dyed silk brocade, a glint of fine mail at the chest, wide sleeves embroidered with pale-gold crescents and stars, a red band on the upper arm, a tight black sash set with a glowing jade cup, a headwrap crown-pin of gold. Hands and objects: a light red curved sabre at her hip with a large brown-and-white hawk feather knotted to the pommel; a ring on her right hand with a small live ember glowing red in the bezel. Power: a strong, bright aura of ember-red fire qi shimmers around her shoulders, with sparks floating up like fireflies. Background: a sunlit road in mist, a few small wagons waiting. Light: hot gold spirit-light from the upper left, an ember-red glow at the ring and along her cheekbone. Expression: cool, calculating eyes beneath a patient, pleasant mask, the warmth only on the lips.

people.imagined: At the fire with her young blades around her, pouring wine with a smile like her mother's and a height like her father's. She toasts, the cup sewn on her breast glowing, and she counts who is following.
people.subject: The moment: standing tall at a fire she raises a glowing green glass cup in a toast toward the viewer with a wide, easy smile, as the crowd of young riders blurs behind her. Face: a tall, handsome, strong-boned young woman's face, golden-tan; wide warm dark eyes with a glint; thick arched brows; a straight nose; a wide, charming smile; a small scar through the right eyebrow. Hair: black, long, tied in a high tail with red cords, a few small silver rings and a gold crown-pin. Body: very tall, broad-shouldered for a woman, long legs. Clothing: a master's rich robes: a night-blue brocade robe with a red cord edging and a dune-gold collar, a drifting sand gauze over-robe, wide sleeves worked with pale-gold crescent moons and stars; on the left breast a small pale-green night-glowing cup emblem, glowing faintly; a red band on the upper arm; a dust scarf of red silk loosely knotted. Hands and objects: the raised cup in her right hand, glowing; at her belt a curved sabre; the left hand open, beckoning. Power: a strong aura of ember-red fire qi frames her, with golden sparks lifting from the fire into the dark. Background: a dark orange fire in mist, many young faces with wrapped cloth masks. Light: warm firelight from the lower left, green glow on her chin, a gold rim on her hair. Expression: a wide, easy smile with warm eyes that sweep over the riders, charm on the lips and calculation behind them.

people.imagined: At the Đà Linh well, posting a leg on the board with a neat hand, the small traders gathering. He is proud of his ledger and does not know that someone has read it.
people.subject: The moment: at a well-side board he stands upright in the sun, pinning up a small plain paper with a tidy hand while his keen eyes glance sideways at the viewer. Face: a weathered, tidy, clean-shaven face; calm, clever brown eyes with crow's-feet; level thin brows; a straight nose; a firm, mild mouth with a faint satisfied curve; a neat trimmed grey-flecked moustache. Fine sun-lines fan out from the corners of his eyes. Hair: black with grey at the temples, combed back and tied in a tidy knot under a dark silk headwrap with a gold pin. Body: medium height, compact, straight-backed, neat. Clothing: an immaculate night-blue silk robe with a dune-gold high collar buttoned neat, a sand gauze over-robe, a red band on the upper arm, a folded blue cotton scarf, pale-gold moons at the cuffs, a wide sash; a short sabre at the belt. Hands and objects: a small blank paper slip and a brass pin in the right hand; a thick ledger with a brass clasp tucked under the left arm (cover plain, no writing). Power: a faint ember-red glint of fire qi on the brass pin. Background: a dry stone well-curb with a rope coil, a wooden board hung with small pinned slips, small traders in a cluster, camels, haze. Light: bright gold spirit-light from the upper left, a thin silver rim on his moustache. Expression: a mild, firm, faintly satisfied half-smile with level eyes, the face of a man who likes to be paid and likes the paperwork of it even more.

people.imagined: At a night camp, he sits wiping his sabre with a rag. He has stopped scrubbing the black from his knuckles. He is told it is strength, and he is looking at the viewer as if for approval.
people.subject: The moment: at a night camp he sits with a bare sabre across his knees, wiping its blade with a cloth, glancing up with an eager, hungry look. Face: a long, gaunt, hollow-cheeked young face; sunken dark eyes; thin brows; a sharp nose; a thin cruel mouth in a small smile; pale skin. Dark shadows lie under his eyes and his lower lip is bitten raw. Hair: black, short, matted at the neck, under a dark silk headwrap with a plain gold pin. Body: lean, wiry, slouching. Clothing: a dark night-blue silk robe with a dune-gold collar and a dusty sand gauze over-robe, wide sleeves, a red cord at the shoulder, baggy trousers and boots; fine and clean. Hands and objects (the stain must read): the knuckles of his right hand are stained with solid black marks, clearly dark smudges across all four knuckles, that he no longer scrubs; the sabre in his lap is dark and wet-looking with a thin red line of fire qi along the edge; a pale glass cup at his belt. Power: a dark crimson thread of fire qi runs along the blade and a few red sparks drift up, sullen and strong for his age. Background: dark tents in mist, a low red fire, a single tent flap stirring in the draught. Light: red firelight from the lower left, cold blue spirit-light on his cheekbone from the upper left. Expression: a thin, eager, hollow-eyed smile, brows pulled slightly up, hungry for a praise that is not there to give it.

people.imagined: At full gallop across the steppe, a little tilted in the saddle favouring the bad leg, riding faster so that nobody can see the limp. She laughs into the wind.
people.subject: The moment: at a gallop on a brown horse across a flat moonlit steppe, she leans low and laughs into the wind, her left leg held a little stiffly in the stirrup. Face: a thin, lively, windburnt face; bright, brave brown eyes narrowed against the wind; strong thin brows; a small nose; a big laughing mouth, teeth white. Hair: dark brown, in a long braid streaming behind her, a faded red ribbon whipped flat to the colour of dried rust; loose wisps whip across her cheek. Body: slim, wiry, a rider's crouch, her weight shifted onto the right stirrup, the left knee turned slightly out, a small stiffness a careful eye would catch. Clothing: a night-blue silk robe with a dune-gold collar flapping open, a sand gauze scarf streaming behind her, baggy trousers and boots, pale-gold crescents at the hem; plain and clean. Hands and objects: both hands on the reins of the galloping brown horse; a pale glass night-glow cup on a cord bouncing at the hip; a short sabre on the belt. Power: a few faint ember-red sparks stream off her shoulders in the wind. Background: a pale yellow steppe and a huge silver-violet sky in mist, speed streaks; a second rider, tiny and distant, trails dust at the horizon line. Light: bright silver spirit-light from the upper left, a gold rim on her streaming hair. Expression: a laughing face with streaming hair and bright, squinting eyes, teeth bared to the wind, a tightness at the temple.

people.imagined: At a fire, he drinks from a green cup he won back, laughing before the joke arrives. His chipped front tooth shows. He is drunk on the memory of taking it back.
people.subject: The moment: at a fire he tips a green night-glowing cup to his lips with a loud, open laugh, head thrown back, chipped tooth in plain view. Face (most important: the chipped tooth): a thin, handsome, reckless young face; one upper front tooth chipped to a jagged half, clearly visible in his wide laughing mouth; bright dark eyes; thin brows; a long narrow nose; stubble on the chin. Hair: black, wild, falling over the forehead, with a red silk rag tied at the temple and a few sparks of ash in it; a small chip of dried mud above one ear. Body: lanky, loose-jointed, swaggering; he sits with one boot up on a log, elbow on his knee, the posture of a man holding the centre of the circle. Clothing: a night-blue silk robe with a dune-gold collar worn open at the throat, a sand gauze over-robe slipping off one shoulder, pale-gold crescents at the cuffs, a red cord at the shoulder, a dust scarf; a belt with a sabre; worn but clean. Hands and objects: a night-glow cup of pale green glass, glowing, tilted to the mouth; the other hand holds a pair of dice. Power: ember-red motes of fire qi dance above the cup like sparks from the fire. Background: a dark orange fire in mist, riders' shoulders, sparks. Light: warm orange firelight from the lower left, green glow of the cup lighting his jaw. Expression: arrogant, vengeful, indulgent; laughing a beat early. Eyes bright and a little glassy, cheeks flushed with wine and triumph.

people.imagined: Asleep in the saddle on the escort road, face pressed into the saddle blanket, a woven pattern pressed into his cheek, camel plodding on. He has never seen a raid.
people.subject: The moment: dozing on a camel's back at a hazy gold afternoon, his cheek squashed against the rolled saddle blanket, eyes shut, mouth a little open. Face (most important: the weave): a round, soft, sunburnt young face; a clear red crisscross pattern of the blanket weave pressed into his right cheek; closed eyes; thin brows; a flat nose; a slack open mouth; a thread of drool glinting at the corner; cheeks sunburnt pink across the nose. Hair: black, short and sticking up, flattened on one side where he has slept on it and standing in a tuft on the other. Body: soft, stocky, slumped forward over the camel's hump. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of a young disciple: a night-blue robe with a dune-gold collar, clean, no red band, a dust scarf pulled down, a sand gauze over-robe hanging loose; a night-glow cup of pale glass on a cord at his belt; a small sabre in a wrapped sheath. Hands and objects: one arm hangs loose; the other holds the camel's rope slackly; a woven striped saddle blanket. Power: a faint earth-ochre shimmer of earth qi settles on him like warm dust. Background: a pale desert road in haze, a dun-coloured camel's rump swaying ahead in a column of dust, a wavy heat haze above the road. Light: warm hazy gold spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim on his round cheek. Expression: eyes shut, mouth slightly open and the cheek squashed, a slack, thoroughly sleeping face.

people.imagined: Trimming his beard in a camp mirror with a small knife he swears was his father's. He catches the viewer in the mirror and holds the knife still, as if caught mid-lie.
people.subject: The moment: sitting in front of a small hand mirror in a lamplit tent, he trims a wedge of beard with a small knife and meets the viewer's eyes in the mirror with a slow, smooth smile. Face: a narrow, sly, handsome face; a neat, sharp WEDGE of black beard at the chin, trimmed to a point, the dominant feature; quick, watchful hazel eyes; thin arched brows; a straight nose; thin lips in a smooth smile. Hair: black, slicked back and oiled, tied at the nape under a dark silk headwrap with a gold pin; two thin braids twisted back from each temple and joined with a plain bone clip. Body: slim, a clever young man's poise, one shoulder forward. Clothing: a new night-blue silk robe with a dune-gold collar, too clean, no red band, a light sand gauze over-robe, a dust scarf of blue silk, the same blue as Trấn Sa's sash; a belt with a small sabre. Hands and objects: a small bone-handled knife in the right hand at the beard; a round bronze hand mirror in the left. Power: a faint blue-grey glint of metal qi runs along the knife edge. Background: a tent wall of dark felt in mist, a stacked saddle and a hanging red cord. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left, leaving the left half of his face in shadow so that only one watchful eye shows clearly in the mirror, a thin silver rim on the edge of the mirror. Expression: a slow, smooth smile with eyes holding the viewer's in the mirror, brows lifted as if to be helpful.

people.imagined: Gazing at Hạng Lưu Hỏa from across the fire with shining eyes, her own small cup in her hands, one side of her hair singed short, ready for any order.
people.subject: The moment: at a fire she stares with shining devotion at someone off to the right, hugging a small glowing cup to her chest. Face: a small, round, bright young face, flushed; huge dark eyes shining with worship; thick straight brows; a small snub nose; a small open mouth. Her cheeks are smudged with ash, a small round burn scab shows beside the nose, her lower lip is chapped and a faint freckling of soot spots her forehead. Hair (most important): black hair worn long, but the RIGHT side is singed short, jagged and uneven, a clear difference between the long left and the short burnt right, with faintly scorched ends. Body: small, slight, very young, upright. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of a new disciple: a night-blue robe with a dune-gold collar, a little too large, sleeves rolled, its hem hanging well below her knees, a red wool cord round the arm, a dust scarf; boots too big, stuffed with wool at the toes and pointing slightly inward. Hands and objects: a small pale green glass night-glow cup held to the chest in both hands, glowing faintly under her chin; a scorched strand of her own hair wound round one finger. A plain long straight sword in a red-brown scabbard is slung across the back, its copper guard showing above the left shoulder. Power: a few tiny ember-red sparks cling to her singed hair and float up, small and wild. Background: a fire in mist and a long line of horsemen sitting in shadow against a red-gold glow. Light: warm orange from the lower right, green cup-glow on the chin. Expression: wide, shining, unguarded devotion, brows drawn up in the middle and lips parted, a child ready to be given any order at all.

people.imagined: In the burning stockade, at her desk among the ledgers, taking up the lamp. She has chosen to stay. She looks up once, calm, before she tips the flame.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk in a stockade room, an older woman looks up calmly with a lit lamp in her hand; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a gentle, strong, composed face with fine lines; large dark steady eyes; thin level brows; a straight nose; a small, firm, kind mouth. Hair: black with grey, in a smooth, low bun with two plain wooden pins and a single faded jade pin, a loose wisp fallen beside her ear. Body: slim, upright, neat; she sits with a straight back, shoulders level, and the stillness of a woman who has already made her choice. Clothing: an elder's fine robes in dull plum silk, since she keeps the accounts and not a weapon: a well-pressed plum robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves, a sand gauze over-robe edged with faint pale-gold crescents, a plain sash with a small glowing jade cup; no sabre. Hands and objects: a small brass lamp with a small flame in her right hand; her left rests on a thick pile of bound books (plain covers, no writing) on the desk, a brush and an ink-stone beside them. Power: a soft pale gold halo of quiet qi lies around the lamp flame. Background: a faded brown wall; behind her the paper screens glow with a dull orange as fire creeps along the stockade wall. Light: soft warm lamplight from the lower left; the silk-painting fade turns the palette to ochre, plum and bone. Expression: a calm, level face with steady eyes and a firm, quiet mouth, the resolve plain and unafraid.

people.imagined: At the stockade gate, holding the line alone, a jade cup on his belt. He smiles toward the camp behind him, because his brother has gone through to kneel, and turns back to the dark.
people.subject: The moment: at a gate he looks back over his shoulder toward the viewer with a broad, easy, loyal smile, a curved sabre in his hand; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a broad, rugged, big-featured face; thick black moustache and short beard flecked with grey; warm dark eyes with deep crow's-feet; thick brows; a broken nose; a wide, brave mouth. Hair: black-grey, long, bound with a faded red cloth tied over a topknot with a gold pin, the ends fluttering, a few grey strands at the temples. Body: tall, broad, thick-chested, a fighting man's stance, feet apart and weight low, one shoulder turned toward the dark beyond the gate. Clothing: a high-realm elder's rich robes: a heavy night-blue brocade robe with a dune-gold collar and a high fur collar, a long sand gauze over-robe, wide sleeves worn at the elbows but clean, pale-gold crescent moons and stars along every border, a wide belt, a dust scarf, baggy trousers into boots. Hands and objects: a curved sabre in the right hand, point down; at the belt, a pale green jade cup glowing faintly. Power: a deep, steady aura of ember-red fire qi lies round his shoulders like a banked fire, with a few sparks drifting up. Background: faded dim gate posts and dark night in mist. Light: low warm light from the upper left; the silk-painting fade turns the palette to ochre, indigo and bone. Expression: loyal, brave, indulgent; at peace. A broad open smile, the creases at his eyes deep, as of a man who knows he has done what he came for.
